title: Mileage Overage on Wayfare Rentals Vehicles and Rules of Use
content:
**Rule.** On a Wayfare Rentals (driver vehicle rentals) vehicle, miles driven in a rental week above the class's included miles per week are charged at the class's mileage overage rate per mile. The miles for a week are measured from the odometer readings at the week's start and end, and unused miles never carry over to a later week.

**The overage charge, stated as a quantity.** The overage charge for a rental week is the number of miles over the weekly allowance multiplied by the class's charge per mile over the allowance, rounded half up to the cent once, at the end. The miles over the allowance are the miles driven in that week less the class's included miles per week. The charge is booked at the end of the rental week, once for each week that goes over the allowance, and records the miles over the allowance. A week at or below its allowance carries no overage charge.

**Use of the vehicle.** Personal use is allowed within the mileage allowance; the vehicle may not leave the hub's state, and only the renter may drive it.

## Worked figures on hypothetical odometer readings

| Class | Odometer at week start | Odometer at week end | Miles driven | Allowance | Miles over | Rate per mile | Overage charge |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Wayfare Rentals Economy Sedan | 20400 | 22020 | 1620 | 1500 | 120 | $0.20 | $24.00 |
| Wayfare Rentals Minivan | 8100 | 9653 | 1553 | 1500 | 53 | $0.25 | $13.25 |
| Wayfare Rentals Premium Sedan | 31000 | 32333 | 1333 | 1200 | 133 | $0.30 | $39.90 |
| Wayfare Rentals Midsize SUV | 5000 | 6420 | 1420 | 1500 | none | $0.25 | none |

## Questions on the rule

**The Midsize SUV above drove 80 miles under its allowance. Do those miles help next week?** No. Unused miles never carry over; next week is measured against its own allowance alone.

**A renter drives 900 miles one week and 2100 the next in a Wayfare Rentals Economy Sedan. Is the total compared with two weeks of allowance?** No. Each week stands alone: the first week has no overage, and the second week has 600 miles over, charged at $0.20 per mile, $120.00.

**May the renter's partner drive the vehicle on a weekend?** No. Only the renter may drive a Wayfare Rentals vehicle.
